AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

3. When learning Introduction to Simulated Flying, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Simulated Flying.

4. When learning Aircraft Stability, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Stability.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Stability.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Stability.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Stability.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

6. When learning Aircraft Basic Maintenance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.

7. When learning Aviation Entrepreneurship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Entrepreneurship.

8. When learning Aircraft Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Systems.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Systems.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Systems.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Systems.

9. When learning Cargo Handling, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Cargo Handling.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cargo Handling.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cargo Handling.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cargo Handling.

10. When learning Flight Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Safety.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Safety.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Flight Safety.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Safety.

11. When learning Career Opportunities in Aviation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities in Aviation.

12. When learning Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Basic Maintenance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Stability and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Simulated Flying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
